title: Northwest Airlines pilot's telepathic encounter
summary: James Fox tells of Northwest Airlines pilot's telepathic encounter, about unspecified at Arizona, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: interviewing this guy who was a former I think he was a North Northwest Airlines

plain: James Fox, a UFO investigator, says he once interviewed a man he believes was a former pilot for Northwest Airlines, an American passenger airline. As the story goes, the pilot described an encounter in Arizona in which he felt he was communicated with by mind alone, which, if true, would point to beings that can reach people telepathically.
